Next year marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone's launch, and the iPhone Pro models are reportedly set to receive a completely revamped design. The latest leaked information has revealed the specific dimensions of what are claimed to be larger display sizes.

iPhone Pro models next year will feature larger 6.4-inch and 7-inch displays

In 2017, on the iPhone's 10th anniversary, Apple prepared a particularly significant model: the iPhone X.

There are rumours that the company is preparing a similarly unique product for next year's 20th anniversary.

According to reports, next year's iPhone Pro models will adopt an all-screen display with curved edges on all four sides, with the screen extending to the edges of the device.

The Dynamic Island's cutout may be reduced in size or even eliminated entirely, giving the entire device the appearance of a seamless, all-glass design.

According to the latest post by leaker Digital Chat Station, Apple is also preparing new display sizes. He stated that the company is testing the following specifications:

  • iPhone Pro: 6.4 inches, up from the current 6.3 inches
  • iPhone Pro Max: 7 inches, up from the current 6.9 inches

He added that the overall body size of both devices will increase, but they will maintain the same screen aspect ratio as the current models. In other words, the larger screens are not simply the result of narrower bezels.

The last time Apple increased the screen sizes of the Pro models was in 2024, when the iPhone 16 Pro went from 6.1 inches to 6.3 inches, and the Pro Max went from 6.7 inches to 6.9 inches.

Although the increase next year may not sound significant on paper, the four-sided curved design should deliver a more refreshing in-hand feel and overall visual experience.

What do you think about the rumoured design of next year's iPhone Pro models? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
